items.label: Paystack secret key
items.description: From the Paystack dashboard (starts with sk_). Stored encrypted; it is never shown again.

items.label: Paystack API address
items.description: Leave as it is unless you test against another server.

items.label: OpenStreetMap Nominatim address
items.description: The public server allows about one request a second; run your own Nominatim for real use.

items.label: OpenStreetMap contact
items.description: An email address or website that identifies you to the map server, as its usage policy asks.

items.label: LiteParse program
items.description: The command that runs LiteParse. Some systems have another program called lit: use the full path to be sure.

items.label: LiteParse OCR language
items.description: Tesseract language code, such as eng or eng+fra.

items.label: LiteParse language data folder
items.description: Folder with Tesseract language files, for offline use.

items.label: LiteParse HTTP OCR server
items.description: Use an EasyOCR or PaddleOCR server instead of the built-in Tesseract.

items.label: LiteParse OCR server token
items.description: Sent as a bearer token to the HTTP OCR server.

items.label: LiteParse OCR resolution (DPI)
items.description: 72 to 400. Higher reads small print better and is slower.

items.label: LiteParse most pages per file
items.description: This engine's own limit; the kernel's ocr.max_pages can only lower it.

items.label: LiteParse time allowed per file (seconds)
items.description: 5 to 600. The process is stopped, with anything it started, when this passes.

items.label: Ollama address
items.description: Where Ollama runs. Requests never leave that network.

items.label: Ollama default model
items.description: Used when no model is named here or in the AI settings, such as llama3.2.

items.label: Ollama embedding model
items.description: Used for embeddings when none is named, such as nomic-embed-text.

items.label: OpenAI-compatible API key
items.description: The key of OpenAI, OpenRouter, Groq or your own server; empty for a local server that needs none. Stored encrypted; it is never shown again.

items.label: OpenAI-compatible API address
items.description: The API root with its version. Change it to use vLLM, LM Studio, OpenRouter and the like.

items.label: OpenAI-compatible default model
items.description: Used when no model is named here or in the AI settings.

items.label: OpenAI-compatible embedding model
items.description: Used for embeddings when none is named, such as text-embedding-3-small.

items.label: Anthropic API key
items.description: From the Anthropic console. Stored encrypted; it is never shown again.

items.label: Anthropic API address
items.description: Leave as it is unless you go through a gateway.

items.label: Anthropic default model
items.description: Used when no model is named here or in the AI settings.
